subject: Debrief: Samira Kahn — score handoff & conflict resolution needed
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 16 May 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Debrief: Samira Kahn — score handoff & conflict resolution needed

Hi team,

Thanks for taking the time to interview Samira yesterday. I've attached her resume and my initial filled scorecard (scorecard-SK.xlsx). We have conflicting signals across interviewers: solid coding but fuzzy systems reasoning on one question. I want us to capture final dispositions and decide whether we need a short follow-up ask or move to a hire/no-hire vote.

What I need from each of you by EOD Monday:
- Fill your row in scorecard-SK.xlsx with numeric scores (1-5) and one-line justification (focus on candidate's system-design rationale and coding correctness).
- Call out any "fatal" concerns (yes/no).
- If you want a follow-up question, suggest the topic (e.g., caching, scaling, tradeoffs).

Quick context from my side: I gave Samira a 4 on coding (clean solution, edge cases handled) and a 3 on system design — she suggested a workable approach but missed a couple of latency tradeoffs I expected. No security red flags.

Attachments: samira_kahn_resume.pdf (resume), scorecard-SK.xlsx (please edit your line)

I'll collate and propose next steps after I see your inputs. If we have a clear majority for hire we can skip follow-up. If split, I'm proposing a 30-min follow-up focused on the ambiguous design point.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Staff Engineer, Hiring Panel
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Debrief: Samira Kahn — score handoff & conflict resolution needed

Diego — thanks for the note. I updated the scorecard (row: marissa). TL;DR: 4 on coding, 3 on systems.

Notes:
- Coding: Good test coverage on edge cases, few nitpicks on variable naming but nothing blocking.
- Systems: She proposed async batching which is fine, but left out backpressure and admission control for sustained spikes — that's a concern at our scale. I'd mark that as an area to probe but not fatal.

Follow-up suggestion: one pointed question on handling sustained traffic bursts (admission control + fallback). 15-20 minutes should be enough.

On my calendar Monday afternoon for a quick sync if we need to finalize.

—Marissa

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2026 12:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Debrief: Samira Kahn — score handoff & conflict resolution needed

On Sun, May 16, 2026 at 11:02 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Diego — thanks for the note. I updated the scorecard (row: marissa). TL;DR: 4 on coding, 3 on systems.
>
> Follow-up suggestion: one pointed question on handling sustained traffic bursts (admission control + fallback). 15-20 minutes should be enough.

I updated my row too (row: mina). My view: 3 on coding (some off-by-one in a helper), 2 on systems (she didn't articulate how state would be sharded or how KV cache invalidation works for the design she suggested).

I am leaning toward a short follow-up but would push a concrete small task if we move forward — e.g., ask for a 1-page design note after the follow-up, specifically around cache invalidation and failure modes. That would give us a clearer signal without a full onsite.

If others are neutral/positive, I'm okay with follow-up + design note as a gate. If others call fatal, we should stop here.

—Mina

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2026 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Debrief: Samira Kahn — score handoff & conflict resolution needed

Diego / all — quick data point from my interview: I gave Samira a 4 on coding and a 4 on systems. She answered the KV invalidation question with the primary/secondary + sequence number approach; I asked for latency/consistency tradeoffs and she called out cross-region staleness with an acceptable mitigation. To my read, she understands failure modes.

I know Mina saw gaps; I think part of the difference is the framing of the question. My recommendation: schedule a short 20–30 minute follow-up with a focused scenario (cache invalidation under partial failures) and ask for a short written note after. That should resolve the disagreement without taking a full loop.

Greenhouse: candidate page https://greenhouse.example/candidates/987654 — I've left a +1 comment there as well.

If we go that route, I'm happy to run the follow-up or shadow.

—Rishi

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Samira Kahn <samira.kahn@gmail.com>, Elena Park <elena.park@zephyrai.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Debrief: Samira Kahn — score handoff & conflict resolution needed

Thanks everyone — good discussion and helpful to see the split. Summary and proposed plan: 

- Current tally (from scorecard-SK.xlsx): Marissa 4/3, Mina 3/2, Rishi 4/4, Diego 4/3 => leaning +1 for follow-up rather than immediate hire.
- Decision: schedule a 25-minute focused follow-up with Samira on cache invalidation and admission control. Ask for a 1-page design note within 48 hours of the follow-up.
- Owner: Rishi to lead the follow-up (Rishi volunteered).
- Logistics: Laura to propose two slots Wed/Thu 10:00–12:00 PT; Samira and Elena will be looped for scheduling.
- If follow-up + 1-page note addresses Mina's concerns, we move candidate to senior engineer onsite loop. If not, we close with constructive feedback.

Action items (owners):
- Rishi: run the follow-up interview (25 min) and capture explicit answers (by Thu EOD).
- Laura: propose calendar slots + send invite to Samira/Elena (by Tue noon).
- Marissa & Diego: draft 2–3 bullet prompts for the follow-up to keep it tight (by Tue EOD).
- Mina: prepare the list of failure-mode checkpoints you want covered so Rishi can probe them (by Tue EOD).

Docs & links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aXcj-debrief-notes (I added the summary), Greenhouse candidate page: https://greenhouse.example/candidates/987654

I attached the resume and the updated scorecard for the record. I'll mark the candidate status as "follow-up" in Greenhouse after Rishi confirms the slot.

If anyone strongly objects to the plan, speak now; otherwise I'll proceed with the calendar coordination.

Thanks — Diego

Attachments: samira_kahn_resume.pdf, scorecard-SK.xlsx
